# agent-system

> A command-line coordinator that lets your coding agents work your GitHub issues while you are away, on the subscription you already pay for, up to a limit you set. They open and review pull requests and never merge into main; you do. A fresh install runs nothing until an approval or a grant exists.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/README.md): What it never does, a quick start that ends at a refused dispatch, what you can do, and what each runtime needs.
- [Agent setup steps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/docs/AGENT-SETUP.md): Numbered steps for a coding agent, with the expected result of each, and where to stop for the person.

## Guides

- [Operator guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/docs/OPERATING.md): Setup, authorizing work, subscription admission, the ticket loop, evidence, evaluation, and updating.
- [Local MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/docs/MCP.md): The stdio MCP server, its seven tools, and what it cannot do.
- [Local control UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/docs/CONTROL-UI.md): The operator console and what each action calls.
- [Ticket loop example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mocraimer/agent-system/main/examples/ticket-loop/README.md): A worked example of running the loop against a made-up product repository.

## Page

- [Explainer page](https://mocraimer.github.io/agent-system/): What your agents do for you, what it never does, and how to start.
